item.title: About
item.author: jparedescolmenarejo@gmail.com (Jose Paredes)
item.description:
I am a data scientist and AI engineer based in Madrid. At EIPSA I build computer vision systems and data automation for industrial engineering, from inspection models on the production line to the tooling that surrounds them. Outside of work I build local-first AI products: tools that run on your own machine and keep your data there.

Resume: PDF

Projects

  • Subany — live subtitles in the browser. Whisper and ONNX on WebGPU, with no server round-trip.
  • subany.site — the project site for subany.video.
  • CleanYourMail — a local-first way to clean up a Gmail inbox without handing over your mail.
  • CleanYourPhone — the same idea for your phone: inspect and clean it locally.
  • DocFlow — document automation for industrial teams.
  • Pro POV CS2 — a computer-vision project for Counter-Strike 2 POV clips.
  • GitHub — the rest of the code, including the models published on Hugging Face.

Experience

Data Analyst & AI Engineer · EIPSA

2024 — Now

item.title: FAQ
item.author: jparedescolmenarejo@gmail.com (Jose Paredes)
item.description:
Who are you?

I’m Jose Paredes, a data scientist and AI engineer in Madrid. I build computer-vision systems, automation and local-first products.

What do you write about?

Data, computer vision, automation and local-first AI products: how they work, the trade-offs behind them and the parts that were hard to get right.

Can I use the code?

Yes. The snippets are there to be reused; if a post links to a repository, check that repository’s licence first. Attribution is appreciated but not required.

item.title: How subany.video works: live subtitles in the browser
item.author: jparedescolmenarejo@gmail.com (Jose Paredes)
item.description: subany.video is a small experiment with a deliberately narrow promise: paste a Twitch link and watch the stream with translated subtitles. The video, the speech recognition and the translation all run in the browser.
